title: Deep Antiquity
subtitle: Origins, early settlements and the civilisational foundations of Bharat
abstract: Origins, early settlements and the civilisational foundations of Bharat. This article is a foundation for further research in the History section.

sections.title: Deep Antiquity
content: This section introduces the period and identifies the principal political, social and cultural developments that shaped the history of Bharat.
The article is intentionally structured as a research gateway; individual themes can be expanded into dedicated monographs.

sections.title: QUESTIONS FOR STUDY
content: What are the principal primary sources for this period?
How do archaeology, inscriptions, literature and later traditions complement or contradict one another?

researchQuestions: Which primary sources are most important for this period?
How should later traditions be evaluated?
